source_text: kdr allele screening was conducted on 61 specimens selected from mosquitoes that survived exposure to DDT, permethrin and deltamethrin; 38 (62.3%) were found to carry the L1014F allele at this locus... Twenty-seven samples were homozygous for the L1014 F allele, whereas 11 samples were heterozygous at this locus.
In contrast, the L1014S allele, which is common in East Africa, was not detected.
